frequency_question: How often do threatened indefinite general strikes by major union coalitions actually escalate to a full commencement rather than being deferred or settled?
membership_rule: Includes multi-union umbrella strike threats affecting core national services (such as banking, transport, or public administration) with explicit strike deadlines. Excludes single-employer strikes or uncoordinated wildcat actions.

cases.name: Central Trade Unions General Strike Call

coverage_note: 3 named; captures recent relevant multi-union escalation dynamics in the specific sector.
known_gaps: Excludes smaller regional bank union disputes that did not reach national umbrella coordination.
skeleton: Three major coordinated strike showdowns identified where indefinite or severe multi-day strikes were threatened by similar labor federations.
multiplier: 1 hit out of 3 major comparable showdown instances that resulted in full escalation to the ultimate threatened action within the window.
validity_reason: Labor laws, union leadership structures, and conciliation mechanisms remain stable over a 2-to-4 year horizon.
